items.q: there was a little fella whose name was William Watson... Willie, one time we took a little adventure

ctx.x: (Inaudible) slapped me three times and all of a sudden, I made it. So I kept all of these things in mind and then I remember various little small things about having my little childish ideas and dreams. I had a hobby horse (inaudible), but I put a (unintelli- gible) on it and I was driving this hobby horse (inaudible). Then I remember -- now I remember we moved from E Street to I Street and there was a little fella whose name was William Watson. I believe his father was Haitian because my mother was speaking a…
Willie got excited and started making a lot of those sounds and making a lot of crying and sounded terriable and I didn't appreciate him. I didn't appreciate that. So --
